func BenchmarkProcessRecords(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		db, _ := sql.Open("postgres", "host=localhost port=5432")
		defer db.Close()

		rows, _ := db.Query("SELECT id, name FROM users LIMIT 100")

		}
		rows.Close()
	}
}
